decisions.chronosort_raw_5000MBps: First successful run is warmup only. Finalize script preserves it and reruns this formal point at the end.
decisions.chronosort_compressed_5000MBps: First run is a prefetch diagnostic using generic EphyPress prefetch. Formal runs preserve the current ChronoSort WindowPrefetch policy; finalize preserves and replaces this point.
decisions.default_memory_failure: Initial ChronoSort attempt exhausted the default 1.4 GiB initial GPU owner budget and encountered Windows temp-log cleanup locking. All successful/formal runs use public initial_cluster_gpu_owner_memory_gib=4.0; source is unchanged.
